name: BLIP Base
runtime_note: Use image-to-text when available. Transformers 5 uses the image-text-to-text adapter; rerun Desktop acceptance after changing runtimes. The current starter uses native weights and GPU-preferred placement. Official PyTorch .bin weights need PyTorch 2.6 or newer in Transformers 4.57.3.

name: BLIP Large
runtime_note: Use image-to-text when available. Transformers 5 uses the image-text-to-text adapter; rerun Desktop acceptance after changing runtimes.

name: Florence-2 Base (Community)
runtime_note: Use a native Florence-2 build and a caption task token. Region and detection tasks are outside Caption Records.

name: Microsoft Florence-2 Base (legacy remote code)
runtime_note: The original model card requires remote code and its processor differs from the native integration. Use Florence-2 Base (Community) for this extension.

name: Qwen3.5 4B
runtime_note: Qwen3.5 architecture support starts in Transformers 5.2.0. An isolated 5.22.2 setup was previously cited. Inference still needs Desktop testing.

name: BLIP-2 OPT 2.7B
runtime_note: Upstream image captioning architecture. Use a raw caption profile and check runtime and memory on Desktop.

name: ViT-GPT2 Captioning
runtime_note: Upstream image captioning architecture. Use a raw caption profile and check runtime and memory on Desktop. Official PyTorch .bin weights need PyTorch 2.6 or newer in Transformers 4.57.3.

name: InstructBLIP Vicuna 7B
runtime_note: Upstream documents an image and text processor. Pipeline routing and memory requirements need Desktop testing. The legacy image-to-text task may need explicit Q-Former inputs.

name: InstructBLIP Vicuna 13B
runtime_note: Upstream documents an image and text processor. Pipeline routing and memory requirements need Desktop testing. The legacy image-to-text task may need explicit Q-Former inputs.

name: SmolVLM2 2.2B Instruct
runtime_note: Requires num2words and a compatible torchvision for the processor. Flash Attention is optional. The LoRA example has additional requirements.

name: CapRL Qwen3-VL 4B
runtime_note: Native Qwen3-VL image-and-text chat processor. Requires a compatible torchvision build. Configuration and image input checked on 4.57.3 and 5.22.2. Detailed Description is the starting style; other instruction styles are experimental for this checkpoint.

name: CLIP ViT-B/32
runtime_note: Use with Zero-Shot Image Classification and a list of candidate labels. Scores are model scores. Official PyTorch .bin weights need PyTorch 2.6 or newer in Transformers 4.57.3.

name: SmolLM2 135M Instruct
runtime_note: Text-only. Connect to the existing Synthesize Caption node or use a custom text workflow.

name: XtremeDistil Zero-Shot
runtime_note: Text-only. Use with Zero-Shot Text Classification to score labels against existing captions.

name: BLIP Keyword Captions (Candra)
runtime_note: Native BLIP, trained to return comma-separated keyword text from an image. The legacy task adapts to image-text-to-text where required.

name: PromptGen v2 Base (Disty0 conversion)
runtime_note: Native conversion of the MiaoshouAI PromptGen fine-tune. Uses Florence caption tokens plus PromptGen-specific text tasks. Leave Trust Remote Code off.

name: PromptGen v2 Large (Disty0 conversion)
runtime_note: Native conversion of the MiaoshouAI PromptGen fine-tune. Uses Florence caption tokens plus PromptGen-specific text tasks. Leave Trust Remote Code off.

name: Florence-2 Flux Base
runtime_note: Native processor lacks the required image token. The card uses a custom processor with <DESCRIPTION> and an instruction. Use standard Community Florence for a native captioning baseline.

name: Florence-2 Flux Large
runtime_note: Native config substitutes base vision dimensions, and the native processor lacks the required image token. The card uses a custom processor with <DESCRIPTION> and an instruction.

name: PromptGen v2 Base (original)
runtime_note: Native config cannot resolve florence2_language, and the native processor lacks the required image token. Choose the separately published PromptGen v2 Base (Disty0 conversion).

name: PromptGen v2 Large (original)
runtime_note: Native config cannot resolve florence2_language, and the native processor lacks the required image token. Choose the separately published PromptGen v2 Large (Disty0 conversion).
